author: OpenAI
description:
The next generation is already building the future with AI.

The ChatGPT Futures Class of 2026 came together in San Francisco to share the ideas they're pursuing, the projects they're building, and the experiences that inspired them to start.

As the first graduating class to have ChatGPT throughout college, they offer a glimpse of how young builders, researchers, creators, and advocates are turning new tools into real-world progress.
title: Meet the ChatGPT Futures, Class of 2026

description: We’re excited to launch our new Monday Morning series, a leadership first take on going from idea to action in the AI era. First up is Tom Eggemeier, CEO at Zendesk who shares the one question that every CEO should ask of their board, and the Monday morning routine that sets him up for success. Grab your coffee. Buckle up. 🚀
title: How Zendesk CEO Tom Eggemeier goes from Idea to Action
